scope_detail: National programme; not eligibility of every person, business or locality.
qualifying_base: Eligible net innovation profits after the box threshold

conditions: Eligibility differs for smaller and larger taxpayers; qualifying profits must exceed deducted development costs; asset and income records required.
exclusions: Innovation losses remain deductible at the ordinary rate. Not a 9% rate on all profits.
